# Deposit Register Detail Rules to Computed
`zhi2-web-admin/src/views/maintenance/depositRegister/detail.vue` refactors validation rules from data to computed and fixes a service charge comparison bug.
## Solution
- Rules moved from `data()` to `computed` returning a config object to depend on reactive data
- Validator keeps `this.validateTransactionDate` and arrow-function `this` binding
- Service charge comparison fixed: `Number(this.form.transactionAmount) <= Number(this.form.serviceCharge)` replaces `Number(this.form.transactionAmount <= Number(this.form.serviceCharge))`

# ESLint Pre-commit Failure Fix
`request.js` ES2022 class fields and a virtual module import broke pre-commit ESLint checks in zhi2-web-admin.
## Root Cause
- `request.js` uses class field `timer=null` (ES2022) but `.eslintrc.cjs` sets `parserOptions.ecmaVersion` to `2021`
- `SvgIcon/index.vue` imports `virtual:svg-icons-register` virtual module, triggering `import/no-unresolved`
## Fix
- Change `ecmaVersion` to `2022` in `zhi2-web-admin/.eslintrc.cjs`
- Add `// eslint-disable-next-line import/no-unresolved` above the import in `SvgIcon/index.vue`
## Files
- `request.js`, `.eslintrc.cjs`, `SvgIcon/index.vue`, `zhi2-web-admin/.eslintrc.cjs`
